sentences.en: The boxer had to lose weight for the title match.
sentences.zh: 拳手为了争夺冠军头衔不得不减肥。

sentences.en: A big title does not necessarily mean a high position.
sentences.zh: 一个显赫的头衔并不一定意味着拥有高位。

sentences.en: The title wise is, for the most part, falsely applied.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这个称号大多数情况下是被错误赋予的。
